text:
maya: Quick design check - small variation of the onboarding banner plus sample project cards ready in Figma. Need accessibility + copy nits before we freeze.
dena: link please? Prefer inline top banner that expands to a side panel (not modal). Keeps context.
maya: https://www.figma.com/file/ZZZZ/onboard-compact (mock link). Banner shows 3-step checklist and a "Start your first project" CTA.
olivia: Inline is good. Accessibility nit: CTA contrast around 2.8:1 on light bg, needs to hit 4.5:1 for AA body text. Also ensure focus ring visible in dark theme.
jamie: Event plan: fire onboarding.view, onboarding.step_click, onboarding.template_selected, onboarding.completed. Include step timestamps for durations.
design: Copy suggestions: "Start your first project" + microcopy "~5 minutes with sample data". Steps: "Create API key", "Run sample", "Inspect output" (keep <=3 words).
aria: Sample templates: "Support helper" (low-cost chat) and "Docs search" (embeddings). Show tiny badges: "low-cost" / "interactive" and token estimate + expected latency.
dena: UX: show curl + minimal JS by default. Also include a "Try in Playground" link. Progress indicator: prefer subtle avatar dot that expands to checklist on click.
jamie: QA checklist to handoff: keyboard nav order, visible focus, aria labels per step, aria-live for completion, color contrast tests, axe run, and one screen reader smoke test.
design: I'll push updated artboard with high-contrast CTA variant and collapsed/expanded states by EOD.
aria: I'll draft READMEs for both templates with estimated tokens, sample payloads, and cost notes.
devx-bot: Reminder: please add analytics schema to the onboarding tracker before handing off to backend.
maya: Awesome. Action items: design updates (design), READMEs (aria), snippets + playground link (dena), analytics schema (jamie). Review 10:30 AM PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
